order: Treat the inert tier and the verification manifest as review policy, not features of one engine. The review runner is inherently the cross-vendor engine's driver, but policy must bind every review path, including the section 5 fallback, in-session review by the Director when that engine is unavailable, and any future engine. In `ORCHESTRA.md` section 8.3, reword the tier as policy: whoever reviews verifies the inertness claim from the diff, the runner enforces it automatically, a fallback review applies the identical rule by hand; declare the manifest the canonical command set for every verifier. In section 5, make the fallback review inherit the full policy, verifying tier claims from the diff, judging pasted verification against the manifest, and recording the tier and depth actually run. Document the policy/transport split in the README and the runner header.
claims: All three sub-items landed. Section 8.3 rewords the tier as review policy binding whoever reviews, and declares the `verification` manifest the canonical command set for every verifier. Section 5 now carries all three inherited obligations: verify a declared inert-tier claim from the diff, judge the executor's pasted verification against the project's manifest, and record the tier and depth actually run. README and the runner header document the policy/transport split. This was verified by grepping `manifest` across the changed files, which returns three hits, in section 8.3 item 3, in section 5, and in the README bullet.
